author: SethDGamre + Egzothicki
description: For games with the Zombies modoption. Shows a countdown over every wreck telling you exactly when it reanimates, straight from the timer the game now publishes for this purpose. White with plenty of time, purple as the rise nears, pulsing in the final seconds. The countdown reacts the moment a corpse is reclaimed or resurrected, and a purple '?' marks fogged wrecks whose timer may have changed unseen. Heaps show the full time until the zombie, not just until they turn back into a wreck. Also has an optional top bar panel, off by default, with the zombies' current tech state: a bar for how fast zombie labs build, plus the tech estimate and exact numbers in Advanced mode. Display only.
